title: Igusa Stacks and the Cohomology of Shimura Varieties II
summary: We construct Igusa stacks for all Shimura varieties of abelian type and derive consequences for the cohomology of these Shimura varieties. As an application, we prove that the Fargues--Scholze local Langlands correspondence agrees with the semi-simplification of the local Langlands correspondences constructed by Arthur, Mok and others, for all classical groups of type $A$, $B$ and $D$; this extends work of Hamann, Bertoloni Meli--Hamann--Nguyen and Peng.
